lines.en: label day24:
scene bedroom_day
I am ruthlessly sodomized by sunlight the moment I open my eyes because, for some strange reason, I decided against closing my blinds before going to sleep last night.
lines.zh: 我一睁眼就被阳光无情地爆了菊，因为不知为何，我昨晚睡前决定不拉上百叶窗。

lines.en: This poor decision (Or lack thereof) has resulted in me waking up roughly two hours ahead of schedule without an idea of what to do or the motivation to go back to sleep.
lines.zh: 这个糟糕的决定（或者说没做决定）导致我比计划早了大约两个小时醒来，既不知道该干什么，也没有回去睡的动力。

lines.en: I wouldn’t be surprised if Ami isn’t even awake yet, given how it’s the weekend and everything.
lines.zh: 考虑到今天是周末什么的，要是 Ami 还没醒，我一点都不会意外。

lines.en: And while she refuses to let a day go by without preparing breakfast for me, I assume there’s not a chance in Hell that she’d go out of her way to get all that ready {i}this{/i} early.
lines.zh: 虽说她一天都不肯落下给我做早饭这件事，但我觉得她绝不可能特意{i}这么{/i}早就把一切准备好。

lines.en: I know that 7:00 AM might not be {i}that{/i} early for some people- and {i}I{/i} should be one of them given how I’m normally up around this time to head to school anyway-
lines.zh: 我知道对有些人来说早上七点不算{i}早{/i}——而按理说{i}我{/i}也该是其中之一，毕竟平时这个时候我本来就起床准备去学校了——

lines.en: But the weekend is different.
lines.zh: 但周末不一样。

lines.en: Today is supposed to be a day of rest and relaxation.
lines.zh: 今天本该是休息放松的一天。

lines.en: But...now?
lines.zh: 可是……现在呢？

lines.en: Now I might have to starve all because of a foolish mistake I made and how the sun is a relentless bitch with no regard for those of us who prefer sleeping in on our off days.
lines.zh: 现在，我可能得饿肚子了，全怪我自己犯的蠢，也怪太阳是个毫不留情的婊子，根本不顾我们这些休息日想睡懒觉的人。

lines.en: My head meets my pillow once more as I wait for Ami to come rescue me from my woes with breakfast in bed.
lines.zh: 我的头又落回枕头上，等着 Ami 端着床上早餐来把我从苦难中解救出来。

lines.en: scene black
But I give up within minutes because I can not wait that long and am probably going to die if I don’t eat something immediately.
lines.zh: 可没过几分钟我就放弃了，因为我实在等不了那么久，再不马上吃点东西大概会死。

lines.en: scene lr_day
I step out into the living room and my worst nightmare becomes a reality- Ami is still asleep.
lines.zh: 我走进客厅，最糟的噩梦成了现实——Ami 还在睡。

lines.en: I think this might be the first time the two of us have been home with only {i}me{/i} being awake and, while that doesn’t sound like much, it’s actually quite...unsettling.
lines.zh: 我想，这大概是我俩头一次同处一室却只有{i}我{/i}醒着；虽然听起来没什么，但实际上相当……让人不安。

lines.en: I think to myself about whether or not {i}I{/i} should attempt to prepare breakfast today, but then remember that prepared meals are a thing that exist and elect to remain as useless as always.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}心里琢磨着今天要不要试着做顿早饭，但随即想起「现成的饭」这种东西是存在的，于是决定继续像往常一样废物下去。

lines.en: Would it be nice to do something for Ami for a change? Sure.
lines.zh: 偶尔为 Ami 做点什么，会不会很好？当然会。

lines.en: She’s made my life nothing short of a brisk walk through the park up to this point, but...
lines.zh: 到目前为止，她把我的生活变得简直就像在公园里散步一样轻松，不过……

lines.en: Must such efforts be rewarded with something as uncharacteristic and unusual as that?
lines.zh: 这样的付出，非得用那么不符合我人设、又那么反常的东西来回报吗？

lines.en: No. No, such efforts should be rewarded with something greater.
lines.zh: 不。不，这样的付出该用更伟大的东西来回报。

lines.en: Which is how I will rationalize the fact that I am about to go wake up Ami instead of venturing a little outside of my comfort zone and attempting to cook.
lines.zh: 我就这样为自己正要去叫醒 Ami、而不是稍微走出舒适圈试着下厨这件事找到了理由。

lines.en: I’m sure this is what she’d want anyway since the idea of me having to work around here seems...completely off limits to her for some reason.
lines.zh: 我敢说她本来就希望如此，毕竟不知为什么，「要我在家里干活」这个念头对她来说似乎……完全是个禁区。

lines.en: Either way, I apologize in advance if you were hoping to stay asleep, Ami.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Ami，要是你本打算继续睡，我先道个歉。

lines.en: But this is something that simply must be done.
lines.zh: 但这件事是非做不可的。

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast1
I knock on Ami’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Ami 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast2
She doesn’t answer right away, leading me to believe that she is still deeply asleep...so I knock again just to be sure.
lines.zh: 她没有立刻回应，让我觉得她还睡得很沉……于是我又敲了一次，好确认一下。

lines.en: : Ami, are you alive in there? Because I don’t mean to worry you, but I might {i}not{/i} be for much longer if I don’t eat soon.
lines.zh: : Ami，你还活着吗？我{i}不是{/i}想吓你，不过我要是再不吃东西，可能就活不久了。

lines.en: Again, there’s no answer. And I’m unable to open the door either as she’s taken it upon herself to actually lock it for once.
lines.zh: 还是没有回应。而且我也打不开门，因为她这回居然主动把门锁上了。

lines.en: Alright, well...you can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: 好吧，那么……你可不能说我没试过。

lines.en: I’ll just get her something from the convenience store or something. {i}That{/i} can be my good deed for the month.
lines.zh: 我就去便利店给她买点什么吧。这就能当我{i}这个{/i}月的好人好事了。

lines.en: scene black
I head back to my bedroom to get dressed, hoping that I’m able to actually {i}locate{/i} a convenience store since I haven’t really been to any around here just yet...
lines.zh: 我回卧室换衣服，心里盼着真能{i}找到{/i}便利店，毕竟这一带我还真没去过几家……

lines.en: scene happy9
scene colorbars
scene happy9
scene colorbars
scene newfrenchtoast4
: AHH!~~~~ HAH!~~~~ AAAAAHH!~~~~~
: GOTTA...HURRY UP AND...FINISH!~~~
lines.zh: : 得……快一点……结束！~~~

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast5
: Aaahhh...hah...oh my God...he was right there...he was...right outside the door...
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊……哈……天哪……他就在那儿……他……就在门外……

lines.en: : What if I hadn’t locked it?...Why {i}did{/i} I lock it?...He almost saw...He almost saw me...
lines.zh: : 要是没锁门怎么办？……我为什么要{i}锁{/i}门？……他差点就看见了……他差点就看见我了……

lines.en: : Sensei...come back and help me...I’ll unlock the door for you! I’ll let you do whatever you want to me!
lines.zh: : Sensei……回来帮帮我……我给你开门！你想对我做什么都行！

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast4
: HAHH!!! AAAHHH!!! WHY’D YOU...HAVE TO WAKE UP SO EARLY TODAY?!
lines.zh: : 哈啊！！！啊啊啊！！！你为什么……偏偏今天要起这么早？！

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast1
: Did you say something? I was just walking past your room and-
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么了吗？我只是路过你房间，然后——

lines.en: : AHH! UHH...NOPE! JUST...AHHH! JUST...HAD A REALLY BAD DREAM! THAT’S ALL!
lines.zh: : 啊！呃……没有！只是……啊啊啊！只是……做了个特别可怕的梦！就这样！

lines.en: : NOTHING WEIRD IS GOING ON IN HERE! NOTHING AT ALL! DON’T MIND ME!
lines.zh: : 这里什么奇怪的事都没发生！什么都没有！别管我！

lines.en: : Are you masturbating in there?
lines.zh: : 你在里面自慰吗？

lines.en: : NGH!
Ami (Who may or may not be currently fingering herself) bumps into something rather violently and somehow manages to shake the entire house.
lines.zh: Ami（她此刻可能正在、也可能没有在用手指弄自己）相当猛烈地撞上了什么东西，不知怎么还把整栋房子都震了一下。

lines.en: : NO! NO WAY! I DON’T DO THINGS LIKE THAT, SENSEI! I’M A...GOOD...GIRL!
lines.zh: : 不！才没有！我才不会做那种事，Sensei！我是个……好……女孩！

lines.en: : Okay, well...have fun {i}being a good girl{/i} while I go get us breakfast at the convenience store.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那么……你就继续{i}当个好女孩{/i}吧，我去便利店给咱俩买早饭。

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast6
: What?! You’re just going to leave me behind like this?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你就这么把我丢下不管了？！

lines.en: : Like what? I thought you were sleeping?
lines.zh: : 哪样？我以为你在睡觉啊？

lines.en: : The bad dream woke me up! I’m obviously ready to start the day now!
lines.zh: : 是那个噩梦把我吵醒的！我现在显然已经准备好开始这一天了！

lines.en: : Cool. Then why don’t you come on out?
lines.zh: : 好啊。那你干嘛不出来？

lines.en: : Because I...can’t right now!
lines.zh: : 因为我……现在不行！

lines.en: : Because you’re masturbating, right?
lines.zh: : 因为你在自慰，对吧？

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast7
: I AM NOT MASTURBATING!
lines.zh: : 我没有在自慰！

lines.en: (She was masturbating.)
lines.zh: （她就是在自慰。）

lines.en: scene black
: Wait just...one second...mister!
lines.zh: : 等……一下……先生！

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast8
: Where do.......you think you’re going.......without me?........
lines.zh: : 你以为………你要去哪儿………丢下我？………

lines.en: : Ami, don’t rush things like that. You’re at a delicate age and are going to wind up hurting yourself.
lines.zh: : Ami，别这么急。你正处在一个微妙的年纪，会弄伤自己的。

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast9
: But......I........That’s not what was happening in there!
lines.zh: : 可是………我…………里面发生的不是那么回事！

lines.en: : So you’re just beet red and out of breath because of...sleeping?
lines.zh: : 所以你脸红成这样、上气不接下气，是因为……睡觉？

lines.en: : It was a really spooky dream!
lines.zh: : 那是个特别吓人的梦！

lines.en: : Listen, I don’t know what the big deal about just admitting this is when you’ve been extremely open about everything else thus far...
lines.zh: : 听着，你到目前为止对其他事都坦白得不得了，我不明白承认这件事有什么大不了的……

lines.en: : But I’m not going to try and make you feel any {i}more{/i} awkward than you already do.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不打算让你比现在{i}更{/i}尴尬。

lines.en: : Things like this are obviously going to happen on both sides if the two of us are living together.
lines.zh: : 我俩住在一起，这种事显然两边都会发生。

lines.en: : That’s...well...when you...put it that way-
lines.zh: : 这……嗯……你这么……一说——

lines.en: : But 7:00 in the morning, Ami? Come on. How do you even have that sort of energy at this hour?
lines.zh: : 可是早上七点，Ami？拜托。你这个点哪来的那种精力啊？

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast10
: I’M A GROWING GIRL, OKAY?! NOW, CAN YOU PLEASE STOP EMBARRASSING ME ABOUT THIS?! THIS IS NOT THE REACTION I WANTED!
lines.zh: : 我还在长身体好吗？！现在，你能不能别再拿这事让我难堪了？！我想要的反应根本不是这样！

lines.en: : Oh? What kind of reaction {i}did{/i} you want, then?
lines.zh: : 哦？那你{i}想要{/i}什么样的反应？

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast11
: Mmm!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！

lines.en: : So, ignoring that, can we go get breakfast now?
lines.zh: : 那么，略过这个不谈，我们现在能去吃早饭了吗？

lines.en: : Can I get a drink of water first?
lines.zh: : 我能先喝口水吗？

lines.en: : Dehydrated from dreaming so much?
lines.zh: : 做梦做太多了，脱水了？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Yes I am.
lines.zh: : 我就是脱水了。

lines.en: scene black
Well...it was bound to happen sooner or later.
lines.zh: 嗯……这事迟早会发生的。

lines.en: I just kind of figured {i}I’d{/i} be the one getting caught instead of her.
lines.zh: 我只是有点以为被抓到的会是{i}我{/i}，而不是她。

lines.en: It might go without saying based on how casually I was able to brush all of this off, but there’s really only one thing about this scenario that confuses me.
lines.zh: 看我这么轻描淡写地把事情带过，可能不用多说，不过这整件事里真正让我困惑的其实只有一点。

lines.en: Well, two- counting the fact that my niece is apparently so horny and hormonal that she has to finger herself right after waking up.
lines.zh: 好吧，是两点——另一点是，我侄女显然发情到、荷尔蒙旺盛到刚睡醒就得用手指弄自己。

lines.en: But the most perplexing part of all of this is why she locked the door.
lines.zh: 但其中最让人费解的，是她为什么要把门锁上。

lines.en: Ami isn’t exactly shy when it comes to her feelings about me- and she’s had no issue with just barging into {i}my{/i} office or bedroom in the past.
lines.zh: Ami 在表达对我的感情这件事上可一点都不害臊——过去她也从不介意直接闯进{i}我的{/i}办公室或卧室。

lines.en: So why would she go out of her way to put up a barrier between herself and what she seems to want the most?
lines.zh: 那她为什么还要特意在自己和她似乎最想要的东西之间立起一道屏障？

lines.en: I don’t have an answer for that, and it’s not like I expect {i}her{/i} to give me one when she still hasn’t even brought herself to admitting what happened yet.
lines.zh: 我没有答案，而且{i}她{/i}到现在都还没承认发生了什么，我也不指望她能给我答案。

lines.en: But if I had to take a guess-
lines.zh: 不过要是让我猜的话——

lines.en: It’s because she’s not all that different from me at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 那是因为说到底，她跟我并没有那么不同。

lines.en: And that sometimes-
lines.zh: 而且有时候——

lines.en: When things feel too good to be true-
lines.zh: 当一件事好得不像真的——

lines.en: We convince ourselves they aren’t.
lines.zh: 我们就会说服自己，它确实不是真的。

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast12
: So, what do you want for breakfast this morning?
lines.zh: : 那么，今天早上你想吃什么？

lines.en: : Where are we? I thought we were going to the convenience store. This is just some random market stall in the middle of the residential district.
lines.zh: : 这是哪儿？我还以为我们要去便利店。这不就是住宅区里一个随随便便的路边摊吗。

lines.en: : Wow, rude.
lines.zh: : 哇，真没礼貌。

lines.en: : I figured it would be faster to just stop here for some ingredients rather than going all the way to the convenience store for premade stuff.
lines.zh: : 我想，与其大老远跑去便利店买现成的，不如在这儿买点食材更快。

lines.en: : Plus, I know how much you dislike walking first thing in the morning.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我知道你有多讨厌一大早就走路。

lines.en: : Are you sure you aren’t just saying that because your legs are still weak from-
lines.zh: : 你确定你这么说不是因为你的腿现在还软着——

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast13
: Excuse me, Mrs. Market Lady, but do you sell rat poison here?
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，卖东西的大婶，请问你们这儿卖老鼠药吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately not. We had our rat poison permit revoked after some rich blonde girl used all of it for a science fair project.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾不卖。之前有个有钱的金发小姑娘把我们的老鼠药全拿去做科学展览项目了，之后我们的老鼠药许可证就被吊销了。

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast14
: Damn it, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 可恶，Ayane。

lines.en: : On second thought, just make whatever you want to make. And thank you for taking me here instead of the convenience store.
lines.zh: : 再想想，你想做什么就做什么吧。还有，谢谢你带我来这儿而不是去便利店。

lines.en: : That was a very good idea. You are so smart, Ami. You impress me more and more every single day.
lines.zh: : 这主意太棒了。你真聪明，Ami。你每天都让我越来越佩服。

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast15
: Aww, Sensei! You’re too good to me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Sensei！你对我太好了。

lines.en: scene black
scene newfrenchtoast16
: Oh. I forgot to ask because of the crisis I was thrown into first thing in the morning, but how come you’re up so early?
lines.zh: : 哦。一大早就闹了那场危机，我忘了问，你怎么起这么早？

lines.en: : Do you have plans today or something? And, if so...do they involve me?
lines.zh: : 你今天有什么安排吗？如果有……跟我在一起吗？

lines.en: : Well, right now, my only plan is making it through breakfast without being poisoned. But after that, I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 嗯，眼下我唯一的计划就是活着吃完这顿早饭而不被毒死。至于之后，我还真不确定。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. You know I’d never actually poison you.
lines.zh: : 哦，别这样。你知道我绝对不会真的毒死你的。

lines.en: : At least not without poisoning myself as well.
lines.zh: : 至少不会连我自己一起毒死。

lines.en: : Is that supposed to make me feel better?
lines.zh: : 这算是想让我好受一点吗？

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast17
: It would make {i}me{/i} feel better if the tables were turned! We’d be like Romeo & Juliet!
lines.zh: : 要是反过来，{i}我{/i}倒是会好受很多！我们会像罗密欧与朱丽叶一样！

lines.en: : Sure. Except for the part where Juliet isn’t the one who killed Romeo and was just some clingy teenager who wound up falling for the first man she-
lines.zh: : 当然。除了朱丽叶并不是杀死罗密欧的那个人，她只是个黏人的少女，爱上了她遇见的第一个男人——

lines.en: : Actually, yeah. I guess you are kind of like Juliet now that I think about it. But I am absolutely no Romeo.
lines.zh: : 其实，嗯。这么一想，你倒是有点像朱丽叶。但我绝对不是什么罗密欧。

lines.en: : Sure you are! You’re handsome and good with words and you could probably beat anybody I know in a fight.
lines.zh: : 你当然是！你又帅、又会说话，而且打架大概能打赢我认识的任何人。

lines.en: : Plus, you were really good at acting out all of his lines when we used to read it together!
lines.zh: : 而且，以前我们一起读的时候，你念他的台词特别棒！

lines.en: : I...was?
lines.zh: : 我……很棒吗？

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast18
: Yeah. We used to read a bunch of that Shakespeare guy’s plays when I was little.
lines.zh: : 对啊。我小时候我们还一起读过好多那个莎士比亚的剧本呢。

lines.en: : I never really understood any of them, especially with how weird and big some of the words are, but I remember it always being a lot of fun.
lines.zh: : 我其实一个都没真正看懂，尤其是那些词又怪又长，不过我记得那一直都特别开心。

lines.en: : Especially when M-
lines.zh: : 尤其是 M——

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene newfrenchtoast19
: What? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？出什么事了？

lines.en: : Nothing, I just...
lines.zh: : 没什么，我只是……

lines.en: : I just cut myself a little.
lines.zh: : 我只是稍微切到了手。

lines.en: : Ami? Is everything-
lines.zh: : Ami？你还好——

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Yeah, sorry.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。

lines.en: : Breakfast might take a little longer than normal today.
lines.zh: : 今天的早饭可能要比平时多花点时间。

lines.en: : Oh...yeah. Do you need my help or-
lines.zh: : 哦……好。需要我帮忙还是——

lines.en: scene newfrenchtoast20

lines.zh: : 还是……

lines.en: : Or not...
lines.zh: : 还是算了……

lines.en: scene black
Ami bled to death all over the bathroom floor.
lines.zh: Ami 在浴室地板上流血流死了。

lines.en: I keep what’s left of her thumb in a jar on my nightstand.
lines.zh: 我把她剩下的那截拇指收在床头柜上的罐子里。

lines.en: I kiss it before going to sleep.
lines.zh: 每天睡前我都会亲它一下。

lines.en: scene happy9
Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.zh: {i}Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!{/i}
